page_title: HOF 2-1 WER | Hoffenheim v Werder Bremen 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
90+6' Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) latches on to an accurate cross on the edge of the penalty box and sends the ball towards goal, but it's too easy for the keeper.
90+4' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90+2' 2 - 1 Goal! Mitchell Weiser plays a simple square pass into the feet of Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball low into the middle of the goal. 2:1.
90+1' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
88' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Finn Ole Becker is coming onto the pitch as Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
85' The referee allows time for a substitution. Christian Gross will be replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
85' A pass by Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
85' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
82' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
81' The referee blows his whistle, Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
80' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Werder Bremen will take a corner kick.
78' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
78' The attendance is 24000.
77' Substitution. Maximilian Beier did his best and is replaced by Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim).

73' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) has been asking for it and finally receives a second yellow card, followed by a red which means he has to leave the pitch. His manager won't be pleased with him. The team is down by one man and the offending player is suspended for the next match at least.
72' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Nick Woltemade is replaced by Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen).
72' Here comes a substitution. Jens Stage is given a rest as he is replaced by Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen).
72' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Hoffenheim! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Matthias Jollenbeck and both teams have no complaints.

70' There's a break in play and referee Matthias Jollenbeck must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Hoffenheim using VAR. This could be interesting!
70' One of the Hoffenheim players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
69' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) sends a cross in and finds Maximilian Beier inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
65' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) replaces Felix Agu.
65' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) replacing Umut Tohumcu.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) for Marvin Ducksch.
63' There's an opportunity for Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

63' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

58' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
56' The resulting corner from Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is cleared by the defence.

56' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Hoffenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
54' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
54' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
51' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) gets a yellow card.
49' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
49' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) rises above the defenders and places a towering header low towards the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer is prepared and thwarts him.
47' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
46' The whistle blows and Matthias Jollenbeck starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 0 Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
41' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
39' POST! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
38' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) is flagged for offside.
35' A cross into the box from Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) is cleared.
32' Michael Zetterer leaps to intercept the corner kick from Anton Stach (Hoffenheim).
32' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) inside the box. The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
29' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
26' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header low towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann is alert and denies him.
22' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) blows a golden chance from inside the box, volleying the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a miss!

21' Michael Zetterer makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner.

19' A nice lofted cross finds Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save.

18' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
15' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
14' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the free kick, sending the ball towards the crossbar. Oliver Baumann pulls off a nice save, and the score doesn't change.
12' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

8' 1 - 0 Anton Stach produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the bottom left corner. What a brilliant finish. 1:0.
8' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is about to take a corner kick.

7' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the top right corner, but great anticipation by Michael Zetterer allowed him to make a comfortable save. Hoffenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
6' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
5' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
4' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Werder Bremen will kick the game off.
Matthias Jollenbeck got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
